name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Could an American win men's singles at this year's U.S. Open?
changes.summary: The Athletic's Lukas Weese joins CBS News to discuss who has the best chances with the U.S. Open tennis tournament underway in New York City.

changes.title: Daily fragment: TWA Flight 529
changes.summary: TWA Flight 529 crashed shortly after takeoff from Midway Airport in Chicago, killing all 78 people on board. At the time, it was the deadliest single plane disaster in U.S. history.

changes.title: Army Secretary Daniel Driscoll Resigns as U.S. Military Grapples With Two Wars
changes.summary: The resignation of Daniel P. Driscoll, the secretary of the Army, had been expected but comes at a tumultuous time for the service.

changes.title: How the Pentagon Is Getting Into the Venezuelan Oil Business Under Trump
changes.summary: The Defense Department’s Office of Strategic Capital, founded by the Biden administration to give loans to bolster the U.S. defense industry, is helping lead President Trump’s oil deal.

changes.title: U.S.-Venezuela oil deal will rely on North American Blue Energy Partners
changes.summary: The Trump administration's plan to take a stake in tens of billions of barrels of Venezuelan oil reserves will hinge on a private company called North American Blue Energy Partners, the White House announced Monday.

changes.title: Fears of a Canadian trade war are overblown. So far, it’s more of a skirmish
changes.summary: Listening to most of the media and Canada ’s prime minister, you’d think the U.S. and its northern neighbor were in a full-blown trade war after new tariffs were announced days ago. changes.title: Global finance ministers gather in North Carolina for G-20 summit
changes.summary: The U.S. is playing host to finance ministers from around the world this week. Russia's top economic official made a stir on Monday when he showed up in person at the meeting in North Carolina.

changes.title: Days after Trump announces Venezuela oil deal, White House fills in some of the details
changes.summary: As part of the deal, the U.S. is creating a private company as a joint venture with North American Blue Energy Partners, owned by Venezuelan businessman Alejandro Betancourt. (Image credit: Matias Delacroix).

changes.title: The U.S. wants others to join its economic pressure campaign against Iran. Will they?
changes.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel asks former Deputy National Security Adviser Jon Finer about U.S. efforts to cultivate global support to economically isolate and pressure Iran.

changes.title: Vance Defends Approach to Antisemitism in Remarks to Jewish Conservatives
changes.summary: In private remarks, Vice President JD Vance explained why he engages with some influencers accused of antisemitism. He also urged the audience to help articulate why a strong relationship with Israel is in America’s interest.
